notes: «نحو حديث الربيع بن سليمان» points to another report of the same saying: a variant group (rule 4), not a route.
«قالوا فكان مكحول يقرأ» is the transmitters' report of Makhul's practice, not a new link; «قال مكحول اقرأ بها» is Makhul's own statement, part of the saying. The Companion Ubada is the last link.
